items.title: KALZERO — financial infrastructure and platform automation outreach
items.description: Dubai-headquartered financial infrastructure group operating in-house payment, company-formation, brokerage and cybersecurity platforms. Its documented stack includes REST APIs, WebSockets, FIX connectivity, webhooks, real-time processing and analytics pipelines, making it a strong fit for Python backend, integration automation and AI-assisted operations.
items.contact_strategy: Use the official contact form and propose a narrowly scoped API/integration or operational-automation pilot tied to one platform workflow.
items.buyer_or_company_evidence: Official site states that KALZERO is headquartered in Dubai and builds and operates payment, formation, trading and security platforms on an owned technology stack.

items.title: Terafin — digital-banking orchestration and API workflow outreach
items.description: Dubai-based financial technology company serving Middle East and Africa banks with digital banking, payment orchestration, BaaS and tokenized-deposit capabilities. Relevant offer: Python services, secure API integrations, workflow orchestration, observability and LLM-assisted support tooling.
items.contact_strategy: Submit an institution-focused inquiry through the official Talk to Us page, offering a concrete integration or internal automation proof of concept.
items.buyer_or_company_evidence: Official contact page says Terafin is based in Dubai, serves Middle East and Africa, and provides an orchestration platform for licensed banks.

items.title: SalisPay — payment-infrastructure integration automation outreach
items.description: Payment-infrastructure provider for banks and fintechs with UAE, Oman and India presence. The official site describes API-first architecture, sandbox credentials, integration engineering and SaaS/PaaS/on-premise delivery, creating a direct fit for backend integration, test automation and operational AI workflows.
items.contact_strategy: Use the official business inquiry route with a proposal for API integration acceleration, automated reconciliation/testing or support-workflow automation.
items.buyer_or_company_evidence: Official contact page lists the Dubai entity and describes CenterFirst as modular API-first payment infrastructure with sandbox access and integration support.

items.title: Goyzer — AI real-estate operations and portal integration outreach
items.description: UAE-based real-estate management software company with property portal aggregation, lead management and AI-enabled daily workflows. Strong fit for Python/API integration, lead-routing automation, data synchronization and LLM-assisted sales or property operations.
items.contact_strategy: Approach through the official contact form with a workflow audit covering portal feeds, lead enrichment/routing and property-data synchronization.
items.buyer_or_company_evidence: Official contact page identifies Goyzer as a UAE-based AI real-estate management platform and lists a Dubai Business Bay office.

items.title: Tokenizer.Estate — property-tokenization backend and automation outreach
items.description: Dubai real-estate tokenization technology platform serving property firms, financial institutions, funds and asset managers. Relevant services include backend/API engineering, automated onboarding and document workflows, data pipelines, and agent-assisted operations.
items.contact_strategy: Use the official project contact form to offer a scoped automation or integration pilot for onboarding, document handling or platform operations.
items.buyer_or_company_evidence: Official contact page describes the business as real-estate blockchain technology, lists a Dubai Business Bay office and invites project inquiries.

items.title: Almanal Development — property operations automation outreach
items.description: Dubai property developer and leasing operator active across residential, retail and office assets. Suitable non-IT outreach target for automating listing ingestion, tenant and facilities workflows, reporting, document processing and integrations between property systems.
items.contact_strategy: Use the official contact form with a business-process automation proposal focused on leasing, facilities, listings or management reporting.
items.buyer_or_company_evidence: Official contact page states that Almanal has operated in property development and residential, retail and office leasing since 1991 and lists its Dubai Silicon Oasis office.

items.title: AXFINTECH — white-label platform integration and workflow outreach
items.description: Technology provider for regulated trading operators with white-label CRM platforms and offices in Cyprus and Dubai. Relevant fit includes secure backend services, platform integrations, release automation, monitoring and LLM-assisted support or compliance workflows.
items.contact_strategy: Use the official institutional enquiry form and propose a scoped platform-integration, configuration-automation or support-workflow engagement.
items.buyer_or_company_evidence: Official contact page describes AXFINTECH as a private white-label fintech infrastructure provider, with a Dubai operations office and routes for platform, integration and vendor enquiries.

items.title: AI-Powered Budgeting Tool Development
items.description: Open remote project to build a web-based financial-planning application for freelancers, gig workers, students and new graduates. Scope includes bank-account syncing, secure authentication, smart budgeting, overdraft prevention, automated savings and API integration.
items.contact_strategy: Bid on the primary project page with a security-first MVP plan covering bank-data provider selection, read-only versus transfer permissions, backend architecture and staged AI features.
items.buyer_or_company_evidence: Primary project page is marked Open and Open for bidding, says Posted 5 days ago, identifies Project ID 40749852, and shows active bidding activity.

items.title: Full-Stack AI App Engineering
items.description: Open remote build for a production-ready suite comprising a responsive web portal, Android and iOS applications, a cloud backend, Node or Python APIs, CI/CD, tests, logging, an AI chatbot and workflow automation.
items.contact_strategy: Bid through the primary listing with an architecture proposal that separates mobile/web clients, Python or Node APIs, cloud deployment, CI/CD and the AI workflow layer.
items.buyer_or_company_evidence: Primary Freelancer listing was indexed as Open, Posted 1 minute ago, ending in 6 days, with a paid-on-delivery budget of 500-2000 USD.
